description: Estimate the total cost of one bad hire: the salary paid for lost productivity plus recruiting, onboarding, manager time, severance and the cost of hiring a replacement. Use it for a single failed hire with a known salary and tenure. Use employee_turnover_cost instead for the company-wide cost of turnover across many employees, and severance_pay for the pay owed to a departing employee. Every cost line is optional and defaults to the TeamPredict calculator's default; set a line to 0 to leave it out.

annual_salary_usd.description: Annual salary of the role, in US dollars.

lost_productivity_percent.description: Share of the salary paid during the tenure that bought no useful work, 0 to 100. Default 60.

manager_time_cost_usd.description: Value of manager and team time spent on the hire, in US dollars. Default 4000.

months_employed.description: Months the hire stayed before leaving or being let go, 0 to 120.

onboarding_cost_usd.description: Onboarding and training cost, in US dollars. Default 3000.

recruiting_cost_usd.description: Recruiting and agency cost, in US dollars. Default 5000.

rehire_cost_usd.description: Cost of finding and hiring the replacement, in US dollars. Default 8000.

severance_and_exit_cost_usd.description: Severance and exit cost, in US dollars. Default 5000.

name: cost_of_a_bad_hire

calculator_url.description: The TeamPredict calculator page that shows the same calculation, where a person can change the inputs.

inputs.description: The inputs as used, with defaults filled in.

results.description: The computed numbers. Unavailable numbers are null.

summary.description: One or two plain sentences with the headline numbers.

title: Cost of a bad hire
